resources.string: Connected. Waiting for text from the agent.
Enter the sidecar URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080.
Enter the phone token (PHONE_TOKEN in the sidecar\'s .env).
Disconnected while the app was in the background. It reconnects when you return.
The sidecar rejected the phone token. Check PHONE_TOKEN in the sidecar\'s .env.
Another connection to the sidecar replaced this one.
This build allows plain HTTP only to 127.0.0.1. Run adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 and use http://127.0.0.1:8080.
Could not reach the sidecar at %1$s. Is it running (pnpm dev:sidecar), and did you run adb reverse tcp:%2$d tcp:%2$d?
Text reaches the phone only while this screen is open and connected. The sidecar cancels a waiting command when the phone disconnects and never sends it again, so any received text was cleared.
Nothing received yet. Keep this screen open while the agent sends text.
Tap OK to confirm you read it.
OK sent. The agent has your answer.
Timed out. The agent was told nobody tapped OK in time.
The sidecar no longer tracks this command.
The sidecar rejected the phone token.
Could not reach the sidecar. The agent will see a timeout.
